sentences.en: The bill was eviscerated before being passed by the legislature.
sentences.zh: 该法案在立法机关通过之前就被彻底削弱了。

sentences.en: Statutory law is written and passed by a legislature.
sentences.zh: 成文法是由立法机构制定并通过的。

sentences.en: Naima Salhi's party even has seats in the legislature.
sentences.zh: 奈玛·萨尔希所在的政党甚至在议会中占有席位。

senses.zh: 立法机关,立法机构,立法部,（特指）州议会
